import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
colors_breed = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(breed_counts))
breed_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors_breed)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Dogs by District
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(district_counts))
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors_district, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.7)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(district_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('District', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution Across Zurich Districts', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Dog Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 25)]
ax3.hist(age_data['AlterVHundNum'], bins=26, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
mean_age = age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean()
ax3.axvline(mean_age, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean Age: {mean_age:.1f} years')
ax3.legend(fontsize=10)

# 4. Owner Age vs Dog Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
owner_dog_data = df[df['AlterV10Lang'].notna() & df['SexHundLang'].notna()].copy()
# Group by owner age and dog gender
grouped = owner_dog_data.groupby(['AlterV10Lang', 'SexHundLang']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Sort by the sort column to get proper age ordering
age_order = df[['AlterV10Lang', 'AlterV10Sort']].drop_duplicates().sort_values('AlterV10Sort')['AlterV10Lang'].tolist()
grouped = grouped.reindex([age for age in age_order if age in grouped.index])

grouped.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'], width=0.8, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
